description: Returns today's checked items from the Context Pill feed (releases, tools, techniques). The optional days parameter covers up to the last 14 days. Each item has a verification status, a source trust score, evidence links, why it matters and an optional try-this step. The optional topic parameter filters by a word such as 'claude', 'codex' or 'open weights'. Fits questions about what's new in AI, recent models, tools, features, pricing or benchmarks. It covers what's new today or in recent days, not whether an older claim was checked or held up; search_claims covers that.

days.description: Number of days to cover, 1 to 14, ending today (Los Angeles date). Default 1, today's drop only. Days with no drop are skipped.

limit.description: Number of items to return, 1 to 30. Default 15.

topic.description: Optional word to filter by, such as a vendor, product or model name. Leave empty for all checked items in the days covered, up to the limit.

name: get_latest
title: Today's Context Pill drop
